name: art-desk
description: Private dataroom where a game director, a 2D artist, and Claude keep a game's art files and art documents. A hosted Node service on Railway with a thin MCP wrapper.

name: vh-personal
description: Personal ticket hub. One zero-dependency Node file that is both the CLI and a local MCP server, so agents manage tickets.

name: game-studio
description: Zombie Farm's production pipeline. Agents plan, build, and verify each game feature, recorded in a local SQLite store.

name: job-applier
description: Claude Applier runs. One agent fills one job application in the browser and asks Victor before it submits.
